scope.interpretation: The inventory is metadata/readiness evidence. It does not certify a complete market history, venue receipt, broker clock, roll-free continuous series, or economic result. Named acquired-contract windows can be admitted under their own gates without inheriting the exact E0 parent-volume universe requirement.

retained_evidence.exact_e0_missing_evidence: Complete parent-contract coverage/equivalent causal proof, compatible preceding-session volumes, and selected-contract MBP for required windows.

limitations: Raw identity is retained and missing multiplier is not guessed.

Provider receipt plus 250 ms is a modeled availability scenario, not actual strategy receipt.

retained_evidence.roll_policy: Use raw instrument_id, raw_symbol, expiration, activation, and the derived segment. Do not splice prices or treat a continuous symbol as a single contract without an explicit segment identity.

ohlcv_1m.timestamp_semantics: t is the bar interval start, stored as a timezone-naive int64 epoch in milliseconds; values are raw/unadjusted.
ohlcv_1m.receipt: No strategy receipt field or actual receipt capture is supplied by the catalog.

mbp_1.timestamp_semantics: Event-time t; ts_recv/ts_ref may exist in source-specific definitions but are not a strategy receipt.
mbp_1.quality: Retain crossed, reversal, nonfinite/reset, gap, snapshot, and unknown-state flags; do not infer recovered book state from volume matching.

definition.terms: The retained 2021-2025 identity audit has contract_multiplier missing on all 2579 selected rows. NQ has a dated external multiplier=20 USD/point available 2021-03-19; ES has no equivalent retained historical multiplier join. Each raw definition's min_price_increment remains authoritative where present.

physical_schemas_and_clock_facts.clock_policy: Keep event-time as a named baseline. Use provider-received timing only when the source supplies it, and model latency through an explicit LatencyScenario. Register 09:40-09:50 and other timing alternatives as separate wall-clock variants; do not fold them into the RTH clock.

identity_and_roll_handling.completeness: simultaneous_parent_completeness_certified=false for each yearly observation; calendar expiry rank is not prior-volume selection proof.
identity_and_roll_handling.admission_rule: Every selected OHLC window must retain the raw instrument_id and map it to one dated definition/roll segment. If more than one ID occurs, or the boundary is ambiguous, split the window or mark it unavailable/censored.

usable_windows.primary_scope: 2020 onward only for primary model rows; 2010-2019 can support separately labeled Jumbo constructions or ordinary OHLC context.
metadata_ready: NQ and ES 1-minute OHLCV have complete available-year file sets 2010-2026 in the retained catalog, with 2020-2026 files present under /workspace/data/quantpad.
NQ has the strongest companion event evidence: five exact MBP/trade paired hours from 2021-2025 plus the 2024 compact one-hour pilot.

ES 2024-03-11 13:30 UTC is an exact paired MBP/trade hour; ES 2022-03-10 14:30 UTC has 112476 standalone trades and no MBP rows, so it is a negative availability example rather than a usable execution window.
usable_windows.admissible_only_after_bounded_read: A catalog file's presence does not prove that every requested minute exists, that one raw contract ID spans the window, or that a missing bar is no-trade. A window becomes an admitted OHLC study row only after schema, source immutability, interval, identity, and quality checks pass.

missing_bar_semantics.current_evidence: The retained OHLC catalog supplies interval-start timestamps and OHLCV values but no explicit no-trade/closed/quality marker. The retained quality protocol defines a gap relative to a declared expected observation stream, not as merely no trades.
missing_bar_semantics.true_absent_bar_no_trade: Not established by OHLC absence alone. A no-trade classification requires an explicitly declared open/session interval plus an independent complete same-window trade or MBP source showing no event, with the source's coverage/recovery status accepted.
missing_bar_semantics.feed_gap: If a minute is expected by the declared clock and the OHLC row is absent while source completeness or companion event evidence is unresolved, record feed-gap/incomplete/censored; do not impute or call it no-trade.
missing_bar_semantics.closed_or_outside_window: A missing row can be labeled closed/outside only when the applicable dated session/calendar boundary is available. The retained cash calendar is NYSE RTH context only and does not certify CME Globex or instrument status.

narrow_admission_actions.action: Declare NQ as the first pilot root and use a single exact UTC hour with existing companion evidence: 2024-03-11 13:30:00-14:30:00 UTC. Keep the OHLC file, MBP file, and trade file as separate source identities.
Validate the full registered OHLC Arrow schema before yielding rows: t:int64 milliseconds, o/h/l/c/v:double, instrument_id:int32; preserve raw unadjusted values and the complete schema metadata.

Use a bounded generic raw Arrow read for OHLC with explicit source-byte, row, output, batch, and row-group limits. The current complete PartitionStore admission is MBP-specific and cannot certify OHLC; add/register a typed OHLC admission boundary before claiming complete OHLC eligibility.
Resolve each selected bar to one raw instrument_id, definition version, and roll segment. Reject or split mixed-ID windows; never splice adjusted prices across a roll.

Compare OHLC expected minute membership against the retained NQ trade/MBP companion window. Classify absent minutes as no-trade only when companion coverage and calendar/session status establish it; otherwise keep them as missing/censored.
Run the same admission on the other retained paired NQ hours and ES 2024-03-11. Keep ES MBP-paused months unavailable for path/execution claims even when ES OHLC exists.

Register timing variants separately: event time, provider-received time when present, source_high_anchor_06_09, NY RTH, prior-RTH/overnight, weekly/combined, and a distinct 09:40-09:50 alternative. Do not treat the cash calendar as CME venue certification.

Keep dollar/fee conclusions out of the first raw OHLC readiness pass. NQ's dated multiplier=20 is available from 2021-03-19; raw NQ/ES definition rows retain missing contract_multiplier and ES has no retained historical terms join.

bounded_pilot_read_plan.phase_0_static: Use the catalog, roll map, definition audit, source clocks, cash calendar, and companion reconciliation receipts already listed here. No market rows are decoded in this readiness artifact.
bounded_pilot_read_plan.phase_1_one_hour: For the priority-1 NQ hour, declare expected minute interval starts in UTC, select the complete source file and bounded row-group extent, verify exact OHLC schema/metadata and source stamp/hash, then retain every raw field and instrument_id. Record observed rows and the missing-minute classification without imputation.
bounded_pilot_read_plan.phase_2_companion: Use the already identified MBP/trade extents for the same hour. Require explicit source identities, event-time coverage, and recovery/quality states. Compare only within the declared hour; equality of trade multisets is corroboration, not book recovery or full coverage.
bounded_pilot_read_plan.phase_3_identity: Join each bar's instrument_id to the matching dated definition and roll segment. A mixed or ambiguous ID is split or censored. Keep continuous raw price and contract identity separate in all output tables.
bounded_pilot_read_plan.phase_4_variants: Repeat the admitted exact window for event time, provider-received time when present, 06:00-09:00 anchor, prior-RTH/overnight, NY RTH, weekly/combined, and the separate 09:40-09:50 alternative. Each variant gets its own coverage and missingness report.
bounded_pilot_read_plan.phase_5_expand: Only after the one-hour receipt is stable, add the remaining retained NQ paired hours and the ES 2024 pair. Expand by declared dates/windows rather than by assuming the full 2020-onward catalog is one eligible cohort.

resource_bounds.output_bytes: positive explicit max for retained raw fields/IPC
resource_bounds.memory: report observed RSS; the existing NQ compact pilot observed 591323136 bytes peak

conclusion.readiness: NQ 1-minute OHLCV is metadata-ready for a narrow acquired-contract pilot, with exact companion MBP/trade receipts available for selected hours. ES 1-minute OHLCV is metadata-ready for a narrow context pilot, but ES MBP/terms gaps constrain path and dollar claims.
conclusion.first_action: Bounded read of NQ 2024-03-11 13:30-14:30 UTC using the exact OHLC file and the retained MBP/trade companions, followed by raw instrument/roll identity and missing-minute classification.
